cohort: Deliveries in Sweden from 2000-2016, classified as Robson groups 1-5 (singleton pregnancies in vertex presentation, from gestational weeks 37+0)
finding: Postpartum haemorrhage rates increased overall and within most Robson groups in Sweden from 2000-2016, and these changes could not be explained by changes in measured risk factors.
mod_finding: Increasing trends in PPH were found in all Robson groups except for groups 2b and 4b (prelabour caesarean deliveries).
